show.description: With just hours left before sunset to save her company, a fiercely independent CEO impulsively enters a contract marriage with an eccentric Chandni Chowk halwai she believes is ordinary. But as enemies close in and a mysterious poison threatens her life, she discovers her sweet-maker husband is actually a billionaire hiding in plain sight—the only man who can heal her, protect her, and fight beside her in a brutal battle for her empire.
